meta.title: feat(agent): support multiple flow log senders
meta.body_summary: Add configurable multi-senders for flow logs (l4/l7 flow, metrics) with round-robin or hash-based dispatch; implement crossbeam-channel based MPMC queue in agent/crates/public/src/queue/.

perf_labels.notes: Large multi-commit PR with MPMC queue and multi-senders; no review, no benchmark; closed without merge; many compile fix commits indicate agent struggled with Rust build issues.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 11098 changed lines across 170 files, this is an extremely large change driven almost entirely by upstream merges; only a small fraction relates to the multi-sender feature. As a massive PR with no review, closure without merge is expected.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal reviews or substantive PR comments; only a CLA assistant bot comment.
review_details.performance_claim: Support multiple concurrent senders for flow logs to improve high-throughput stability and avoid queue drops.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed without review or merge; no explicit rejection, likely stale or author-closed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Multi-file Rust agent feature with complex build fixes; no maintainer interaction; PR closed without merge, indicating process failure to attract review or meet acceptance criteria.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiler, or reproduction steps; only narrative claim of stability improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR remained unreviewed and was closed without merge; no fix-in-pr cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Add configurable multi-senders for flow logs (l4/l7 flow, metrics) with round-robin or hash-based dispatching; introduce crossbeam-channel based MPMC queue in agent/crates/public/src/queue/; update trident.rs to start/stop multiple sender threads; various build and CI fixes.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The vast majority of changed lines come from merging main branch and unrelated CI/workflow adjustments; only about 200 lines are directly related to the multi-sender feature.
change_trajectory: Initial multi-sender implementation in trident.rs, flow_aggr.rs, config.rs.
Merge of sub-PR adding MPMC queue (mpmc_queue.rs).
Multiple upstream main merges bringing thousands of unrelated changes.
Iterative compile fixes (AtomicsUsize import, clone errors, rustfmt).
CI workflow tweaks and dynamic queue expansion.

review_signals.summary: CLA assistant bot reported all committers have signed the CLA.

collaboration_trajectory: Multiple follow-up commits added MPMC queue and fixed compilation.
Upstream merges brought thousands of lines.
No maintainer review or comment; PR closed without merge.
